Ancient Stirrings.oracle_text: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a colorless card from among them and put it into your hand. Then put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

Brood Monitor.oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
When this creature enters, create three 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature tokens. They have "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."

Chart a Course.oracle_text: Draw two cards. Then discard a card unless you attacked this turn.

Corsair Captain.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
Other Pirates you control get +1/+1.

Departed Deckhand.oracle_text:
When this creature becomes the target of a spell, sacrifice it.
This creature can't be blocked except by Spirits.
{3}{U}: Another target creature you control can't be blocked this turn except by Spirits.

Ghoulraiser.oracle_text: When this creature enters, return a Zombie card at random from your graveyard to your hand.

Goremand.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Flying
Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
When this creature enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature.

Liliana's Devotee.oracle_text:
Zombies you control get +1/+0.
At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, you may pay {1}{B}. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

Liliana's Standard Bearer.oracle_text:
Flash
When this creature enters, draw X cards, where X is the number of creatures that died under your control this turn.

Planar Atlas.oracle_text:
This artifact enters tapped.
When this artifact enters, you may look at the top four cards of your library. If you do, reveal up to one land card from among them, then put that card on top of your library and the rest on the bottom in a random order.
{T}: Add {C}.

Rise Again.oracle_text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Ruin in Their Wake.oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Search your library for a basic land card and reveal it. You may put that card onto the battlefield tapped if you control a land named Wastes. Otherwise, put that card into your hand. Then shuffle.

Scion Summoner.oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
When this creature enters, create a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token. It has "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}." ({C} represents colorless mana.)

Settle the Score.oracle_text: Exile target creature. Put two loyalty counters on a planeswalker you control.

Spectral Sailor.oracle_text:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
Flying
{3}{U}: Draw a card.

Thriving Isle.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than blue.
{T}: Add {U} or one mana of the chosen color.

Thriving Moor.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than black.
{T}: Add {B} or one mana of the chosen color.

Unnatural Aggression.oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Target creature you control fights target creature an opponent controls. If the creature an opponent controls would die this turn, exile it instead.

Voyage's End.oracle_text: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)

Wailing Ghoul.oracle_text: When this creature enters, mill two cards. (Put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.)

Endbringer.oracle_text:
Untap this creature during each other player's untap step.
{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
{C}, {T}: Target creature can't attack or block this turn.
{C}{C}, {T}: Draw a card.

Termination Facilitator.oracle_text:
{T}: Put a bounty counter on target creature or planeswalker. Activate only as a sorcery.
Whenever a creature or planeswalker an opponent controls with a bounty counter on it is dealt damage, destroy it.

annotations.description: Player searched for a Swamp when they already had 2 Swamps in hand and only 1 Forest on the battlefield. They have Ancient Stirrings (G) in hand that requires green mana, and their only green source is a single Forest. Adding another Swamp provides redundancy they don't need while leaving them vulnerable to not casting their green spell.
annotations.actionTaken: Searched for Swamp with Ruin in Their Wake (goes to hand since no Wastes controlled)
annotations.betterLine: Search for Forest to balance mana sources and ensure ability to cast Ancient Stirrings. With 2 Swamps already in hand, black mana is well covered; a second Forest provides needed green access.

annotations.description: By casting Alley Strangler immediately without first playing a land, Llama4 Timmy missed the opportunity to cast both Ancient Stirrings AND Alley Strangler this turn. Playing a Swamp first would give 4 mana total (Forest + 3 Swamps), allowing Ancient Stirrings ({G}) + Alley Strangler ({2}{B}) in the same turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Alley Strangler for {2}{B} using all 3 available mana, without playing a land first.
annotations.betterLine: Play Swamp (land drop) first, then cast Ancient Stirrings with Forest for {G} to get card selection, then cast Alley Strangler with the remaining 3 Swamps for {2}{B}. This gets both spells in one turn.

annotations.description: Discarded Swamp with only 2 lands on the battlefield. The player needs land drops to cast their 3-mana spells (Corsair Captain, Liliana's Devotee, Liliana's Standard Bearer). Wailing Ghoul is a low-impact 1/3 mill creature that doesn't synergize with anything else in hand.
annotations.betterLine: Discard Wailing Ghoul, which is the weakest card in hand, and keep both lands to ensure hitting land drops for the multiple 3-mana spells in hand.

annotations.description: Cast Scion Summoner before playing a land drop. Playing Wastes (or Swamp) first would provide an additional mana source, leaving more mana available after casting the Summoner for potential post-combat plays like Unnatural Aggression or Termination Facilitator activation.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Scion Summoner without first playing a land
annotations.betterLine: Play Wastes first (to maximize mana availability and enable future Ruin in Their Wake if drawn), then cast Scion Summoner, then proceed to combat with more mana open for post-combat actions

annotations.description: Cast Unnatural Aggression to have Scion Summoner (2/2) fight Wailing Ghoul (1/3), but 2 damage doesn't kill a 3-toughness creature. The fight accomplishes almost nothing — both creatures survive. Should have first activated Termination Facilitator to put a bounty counter on Wailing Ghoul, then cast Unnatural Aggression so the fight damage would trigger the Facilitator's destroy ability, actually killing (and exiling) the Ghoul.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Unnatural Aggression targeting Scion Summoner and Wailing Ghoul without using Termination Facilitator's bounty counter first
annotations.betterLine: Activate Termination Facilitator to place a bounty counter on Wailing Ghoul, then cast Unnatural Aggression. The fight damage would trigger the Facilitator's destroy effect, killing the Ghoul. Alternatively, just attack with creatures and save the Unnatural Aggression for a more meaningful target.

annotations.description: Passed priority in precombat main phase with a land drop remaining (3 lands in hand: Forest, Swamp, Wastes) and Termination Facilitator's activation available. Playing a land (especially Wastes for future Ruin in Their Wake synergy) and activating Termination Facilitator to put a bounty counter on Wailing Ghoul would have been free value.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the precombat main phase without playing a land or activating Termination Facilitator.
annotations.betterLine: Play Wastes (or any land), then activate Termination Facilitator targeting Wailing Ghoul to set up its destruction, then proceed to combat.

annotations.description: With only 3 lands on the battlefield and an expensive hand (Settle the Score at 4, Goremand at 6, multiple 3-drops), discarding the only land in hand severely hampers development. The player needs land drops to cast their spells and stabilize at 10 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Discarded Swamp to Chart a Course
annotations.betterLine: Discard Goremand (6 mana, requires sacrificing a creature, unlikely to be castable for many turns) or Liliana's Standard Bearer (very situational without creatures dying). Keeping the Swamp ensures a land drop next turn to reach 4 mana for Settle the Score or to cast 3-drops while holding up interaction.

annotations.description: Only attacked with Alley Strangler when the opponent's lands were all tapped and the only blocker (Wailing Ghoul) had a bounty counter, meaning it would be destroyed if it blocked anything. Attacking with all three creatures would deal 3-4 damage instead of 2 and likely kill the Wailing Ghoul.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only Alley Strangler for 2 guaranteed damage.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with all three creatures (Alley Strangler, Scion Summoner, Eldrazi Scion Token). Alley Strangler gets through with Menace, and any block on the other creatures triggers the bounty counter destruction on Wailing Ghoul, resulting in 3-4 damage total and removing the opponent's only creature.

annotations.description: Blocked Alley Strangler with Wailing Ghoul which has a bounty counter on it. The Termination Facilitator's triggered ability means any damage dealt to the Ghoul will destroy it. Additionally, Alley Strangler has menace and requires two blockers, so a single blocker shouldn't be legal. By blocking, Villain loses the Wailing Ghoul to the bounty trigger instead of just taking 2 damage at 10 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Alley Strangler with Wailing Ghoul (which has a bounty counter)
annotations.betterLine: Don't block - take 2 damage (going to 8 life) and preserve Wailing Ghoul. The Ghoul could be useful as a sacrifice for Goremand later or as a blocker against non-bounty-triggering attacks.

annotations.description: Cast Endbringer before playing a land drop. By playing Wastes first, the player could tap Wastes for the {C} requirement and preserve the Eldrazi Scion token (instead of potentially sacrificing it for {C}) and/or keep Planar Atlas untapped. Playing lands before casting spells is fundamental sequencing.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Endbringer without first playing a land
annotations.betterLine: Play Wastes first, then cast Endbringer using Wastes for the {C} requirement, preserving the Eldrazi Scion token and Planar Atlas flexibility

annotations.description: Did not attack with the Eldrazi Scion Token 1/1 when the opponent is at 8 life and has very limited blocking options (only Wailing Ghoul, which has a bounty counter making it suicidal to block). The extra 1 damage could matter in a race to close out the game.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with Alley Strangler, Termination Facilitator, and Scion Summoner but held back the Eldrazi Scion Token.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with all available creatures including the Eldrazi Scion Token. The opponent can only block one non-menace creature with Wailing Ghoul (which dies to bounty counter if it does), so maximum damage gets through. Every point matters at 8 life.

annotations.description: Cast Brood Monitor before combat when lethal was available on board. With Endbringer (5/5), Alley Strangler (2/3 menace), Scion Summoner (2/2), Scion token (1/1), and Termination Facilitator (1/3) attacking into only 2 blockers (Devotee 2/3 and Wailing Ghoul 2/3), at least 5+ damage gets through against the opponent at 5 life. Should also play Wastes before casting spells for proper sequencing.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Brood Monitor in precombat main phase before attacking
annotations.betterLine: Play Wastes first, then go directly to combat. Attack with all creatures — opponent has only 2 blockers for 5 attackers (one with menace), guaranteeing lethal damage gets through against their 5 life.

annotations.description: At 5 life facing 6 damage, the player only used Liliana's Devotee as a blocker when they had flash creatures (Spectral Sailor, Liliana's Standard Bearer) and Voyage's End available to reduce more incoming damage. Even if they blocked the 2-power Scion Summoner to barely survive at 1 life, they should have flashed in Spectral Sailor ({U}) and/or used Voyage's End on the Alley Strangler to reduce damage further and preserve life total.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked with only Liliana's Devotee, leaving flash creatures and bounce spell unused.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Voyage's End targeting Alley Strangler (removing 2 damage and the menace threat) and flash in Spectral Sailor to block another attacker, reducing incoming damage significantly while deploying creatures.
